title: LiDAR blocked
fullDescription:
Narwhal Freo uses a spinning LiDAR for mapping. Error 1 means it is blocked by hair or low furniture.

Clear obstructions and clean the LiDAR shaft.

fixSteps.title: Move to open area
fixSteps.instruction: Place in open room and reboot.

faq.a: Need at least 4 inches above the LiDAR turret.

title: Wheel jam
fullDescription: Narwhal stops with error 2 when wheel current spikes. Clean any debris.

fixSteps.title: Inspect wheels
fixSteps.instruction: Flip robot and clear hair and debris.

faq.a: Yes — wheel modules available from manufacturer.

title: Main brush jam
fullDescription: Hair on brush bearings stops the motor.

title: Cliff sensor blocked
fullDescription: Wipe four cliff sensors below front bumper.

fixSteps.title: Wipe sensors
fixSteps.instruction: Use microfiber cloth on each lens.

title: Bumper stuck
fullDescription: Tap bumper to free or remove debris.

title: Battery low
fullDescription: Replace battery if capacity is too low.
whenToCallPro: If new battery does not resolve.

title: Mop wash base error
fullDescription:
Narwhal's signature feature is mop self-washing. Error 7 indicates the base cannot fill clean water, drain dirty water, or the heater failed.

Check that clean tank is full, dirty tank is empty, and base water lines are not kinked.

fixSteps.title: Empty dirty tank
fixSteps.instruction: Pour out dirty water and rinse.

fixSteps.title: Inspect water lines
fixSteps.instruction: Verify hoses inside base are not crimped.

whenToCallPro: If heater failed — base service required.

faq.a: Use distilled water in hard water areas to prevent scale.

title: Charging error
fullDescription: Clean dock contacts and verify dock has power.

fixSteps.title: Verify dock power
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm LED on dock is solid.

faq.a: Plug dock direct or use quality protector.
